response.answer: Yes, you can reschedule or withdraw your Board hearing request. If you need to reschedule, you will not lose your place in the queue; the Board schedules hearings in docket order and will reschedule your hearing to the earliest possible date while keeping your original docket date. To withdraw your hearing request, you or your representative should send a written request at least 2 weeks before the hearing, including your name, VA file number, and reason for withdrawal. You can still submit new evidence within 90 days after withdrawing your hearing request. Send your written request by mail or fax to the Board of Veterans Appeals.
